metadata.title: Uniform convergence of canonical discrete uniformization on equilateral approximations
metadata.abstract: We prove uniform convergence of the canonical discrete uniformization maps for every sequence of equilateral polygonal disks whose mesh tends to zero and whose marked Jordan boundaries converge uniformly. The limit is the normalized Riemann map, with convergence on the entire closed reference triangle. This proves Conjecture 7.3 of Luo, Sun and Wu for the original construction with Delaunay flips. The proof combines closed-domain compactness, marked lattice limits, a packing and resistance estimate for logarithmic cusp scales, and an envelope comparison principle, followed by a local affine energy argument.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 离散一致化的全闭域收敛
analysis.workSummary: 证明网格趋零且标记 Jordan 边界一致收敛的等边多边形圆盘，其带 Delaunay 翻转的规范离散一致化映射在整个闭参考三角形上一致趋于正规化 Riemann 映射。
techniques: 包络比较和局部仿射能量
analysis.breakthrough: 确认原始离散一致化构造的收敛猜想，并将控制推进到边界。
analysis.limitations: 需所述等边逼近与标记边界收敛，不能推断任意退化三角剖分或任意离散化都一致收敛。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露生成式 AI 仅用于语言编辑和排版一致性检查，数学构造、证明及验证由作者完成。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26798v1 · 第48页 Declaration on the use of generative AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露生成式 AI 仅用于语言编辑和排版一致性检查，数学构造、证明及验证由作者完成。

analysis.priorityReason: 离散共形几何的关键收敛保证，兼有理论与算法意义。
